column4: Project setup (Gradle/Manifest). Calculator Launcher XML UI — main screen keypad display bottom nav. 7 tool screens (BMI Tip Loan Mortgage Compound Currency Unit). Themes colors drawables strings. First debug build and device run.

Loan and Compound Interest calculators + dropdowns. Currency converter live rates date/time add currency USD-INR default. Side drawer Help FAQs Privacy. History screen. Git commit: new flow and calculation added.

Unit Converter From/To dropdowns with multi-unit data (length weight temp etc). NumberInput.kt unit formulas. Layout and binding fixes. Unit conversion QA.
Calculator + launcher integration. ToolsConfig toggle. Manifest HOME DEFAULT LAUNCHER intent filters. Debug APK for share. Launcher enable/disable documentation.
MI-style home screen (weather card search dock page dots). CustomizeAppsActivity + HomeAppsStore. Onboarding flow (loading intro default-home picker). OnboardingPrefs.
LauncherSettingsActivity dark settings. SearchEngineActivity (Google Bing Yahoo). AboutMenuActivity + revert bottom sheet. Vertical swipe-up app drawer ViewPager2 + NestedScrollableHost.

All apps list fix (QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES AppLoader). System wallpaper on home. Swipe-up gesture improvements. WallpaperDiscoverActivity (Nature Seascapes Space City). Git commit launcher mode. Debug APK.
End-to-end launcher QA (onboarding home apps settings search). Settings Customize Calculator tile fixes. Wallpaper Settings flow + SET_WALLPAPER permission. MIUI device testing.
Final debug APK build (7.2 MB). Work timesheet documentation. Project status review and pending items list.
